scope: lower-workpiece injection-moulding TXT time series only

format.encodingPolicy: UTF-8 with replacement only for non-semantic preamble text; structural markers, units, labels and signal codes must match exactly before values are accepted
format.preamble: semicolon-delimited key/value metadata before the column-description section

channels.semanticCorrection: The author analysis wrapper normalizes this fifth lower-workpiece field under the key injection_velocity, but the source TXT label and unit define volumetric injection flow. MouldMaster preserves the source-native meaning rather than relabelling cm³/s as linear velocity.

sampling.acceptanceInterpretation: Treat the per-file numeric value as the declared sample interval in seconds only when it agrees with successive values in the source time column.
sampling.frequencyDerivation: Hz may be calculated as 1 / validated interval; no global sampling frequency is imposed across files.
sampling.discrepancy: The Zenodo description gives an approximate injection-moulding sampling frequency of ~1 kHz and the author processing configuration comments refer to 0.01 s time steps, while the checked-in lower source example declares 0.0300 and advances its time column by 0.0300 s. Per-file source metadata plus observed time deltas therefore control acceptance.

rules: Both structural markers must be present in order.
The units, source labels and signal-code rows must match the source contract exactly.
Every data row must contain exactly five finite numeric fields.
Elapsed time must be strictly increasing.
Every observed time step must agree with the file-declared sampling interval within numerical tolerance.
The declared plotting-point count must equal parsed data-row count when present.
Target pressure is retained as command evidence but excluded from accepted measured-value totals.
Only source-defined actual pressure, actual screw volume and actual injection flow are counted as measured values.
Any structural, unit, label, signal-code, interval or row-width drift fails that file closed.

remainingFamilyBlocker: Upper-workpiece CSV units are not established by this lower-workpiece contract. The cross-process family must not be claimed fully profiled solely from this partial semantic resolution.
